description: Visual-only adjustments for painted backgrounds (design-doc/ART_DIRECTION.md section 4; schema in src/game/scripts/World/ArtOverrides.cs). game.json stays authoritative for rules and coordinates; rect_nudge [dx, dy, dw, dh] moves/resizes only the hover/click outline, label_offset moves the label; interaction points never change. Each value is at most 40 px. Written by the art pipeline (art/tools/PAINTING.md), checked with art/tools/review_room.py. Unknown keys such as 'reason' and 'master' are ignored by the loader.

S01.tools.reason: The painted service bag spans x 182-326; the rect x 120-240 would cover mostly bare wall. Nudge +40 px and widen by 30 px puts the hit area on the bag (x 160-310).

state_patches.reason: ISSUES ART-VAR-01: the service bag is painted into bg/S01.webp; after G01 the hotspot hides, so the shelf must look empty. Patch cloned from the bare wall x 577-728 of the same background (no paid call).

S05.ambient 1.reason: The vine's leaves and grapes are above the fence top; the rect y 150-250 is half fence pickets. -40 px puts the hit area on the foliage (y 110-210).

state_patches.reason: G04 leaves the grocery bag on the tray (consumed item): the bag (items/GROCERIES.webp, scaled to 92 px, soft shadow) stays visible on the table.
G06 unlocks the shed: the padlock and hasp are covered with door planks cloned 56 px lower on the same door.

S03.ambient 1.reason: The model painted three yellow-black distancing stripes on the low back wall of the shelter (y 180-242) and two tape lines on the floor below (y 305-346). Moving the rect 30 px down and making it 40 px taller (y 180-320) covers all wall stripes and the first floor tape line, so the hit area matches the name 'Páska na zemi' better.

S09.case.reason: The closed brass case stands on the high shelf above the outer door at x 30-215, y 75-180 (body), higher than the template rect (x 120-240, y 150-250, mostly shelf front). -40/-40 px puts the hit area on the case body and its bell emblem (x 80-200, y 110-210).
